intro: Croatian culture blends Central European and Mediterranean influences, from klapa songs to Dalmatian seafood.

chapters.title: Song and screen
text: Klapa, harmonious singing by small groups of men or women, is on UNESCO's heritage list. Dubrovnik played King's Landing in the TV series Game of Thrones.

chapters.title: Food
text: The coast is known for grilled fish, black risotto and peka, meat or octopus slow-cooked under an iron bell. Inland dishes are heartier, with sausages and štrukli, cheese-filled pastry.
